planItem: 77.44.7.A — Code Snippet Inspector property feedback and publication lifecycle
finding: Code Snippet title/source fields exposed aria-invalid and a visible role=status message when the Page Model update was rejected, but aria-describedby did not connect the invalid field to that message.
change: Assign each field validation message a unique DOM id and append it to the input's aria-describedby tokens. Existing command rejection, composition, draft guards and Save/Publish behavior are unchanged.
openSourceReview: Reused the repository-owned accessible validation association patterns in authored content, Social Links and nodeName Inspectors plus native aria-describedby semantics. This targeted defect required no external code or dependency.

assertions: title and source each resolve to a unique role=status target
rejected Page Model update reports the linked validation message
draft Save leaves published source unchanged
separate Publish, inert escaped code rendering and copy

acceptanceBoundary: This proves the listed Code Snippet field validation and browser lifecycle only. Full 77.44.7.A / 79 element × 68 property acceptance remains OPEN / NOT CERTIFIED; manual/physical acceptance remains deferred until the complete Visual Editor is implemented.
